asked.item: Can Blotato automatically repost an existing LinkedIn post (native Repost button) to a company Page

verdict.reason: The help pages directly state that Blotato cannot repost an existing LinkedIn post because LinkedIn's API does not support it, with no exception for company Pages.

steps.text: No. LinkedIn's API does not support reposting an existing LinkedIn post.
Blotato will add native reposting when LinkedIn makes it available via API.
